scenes.title: Chhat Par, Chitthi No. 9
narration: *Sham ki aakhri light chhat ke paani ki tanki par toot rahi hai. Tumhari notebook khuli hai, pen hawa mein ulta-sidha ghum raha hai. Chitthi No. 9 abhi adhoori hai.*
"Bas ek line aur... phir kabhi nahi likhunga. Pakka."
*Neeche corridor mein shor badhta hai. Kisi ne chitthi No. 8 ko notice board se utha liya hai — aur ab woh teen logon ke beech 'Neel' ka naam le rahe hain.*
*Tum pen rok dete ho. Kyunki note tumhare purse mein tha — aur purse Neel ka udhaar wala tha.*
Bablu: "Bhai!! Bhai bhai bhai. Upar aao na. Poora college 'Neel ki chitthi' ki charcha kar raha hai aur tum yahan sunset enjoy kar rahe ho?"
*Bablu haanfhta hua chhat par chadhta hai, haath mein do vada pav. Ek tumhare liye, ek uska. Uska chehra khushi se laal hai — tumhare liye. Tumhare liye, samjhe?*
fallbackLines: *Bablu vada pav tumhare haath mein thama deta hai aur chup chap baith jaata hai. Kabhi-kabhi woh bina bole sab achha kar deta hai.*
Bablu: "Bhai, tu kuch bol nahi raha toh maan leta hoon tu plan bana raha hai. Bata, kya bolna hai? Main repeat kar dunga."
*Door, ground par, Ishita notice board ke saamne khadi hai. Haath mein koi copy nahi. Woh sirf padh rahi hai — aur halka sa muskura rahi hai, jaise koi purani baat yaad aa gayi ho.*
